text: User: A session-scoped Stop hook is now active with condition: "drive all of the issues to completion, with frequent reviews from `codex exec` to ensure we don't drift away in complexity and stay true to the intended architecture -- use opus agents to decide/plan, sonnet agents for coding, PR + merge -- you own landing the PRs in master".
